# Avatar attribution

Adventurer by Lisa Wischofsky, remixed using DiceBear 9.4.3.

- Original work: https://www.figma.com/community/file/1184595184137881796
- Creator: https://www.instagram.com/lischi_art/
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- DiceBear style documentation: https://www.dicebear.com/styles/adventurer/
- Package source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dicebear/adventurer/v/9.4.3
- Generator: https://github.com/dicebear/dicebear

Changes: deterministic selection and combination of original components; curated hair and expression presets, skin/hair palettes, and circular background colors. No hand-authored artwork. Each SVG preserves its embedded creator/source/license metadata.

Suggested app attribution: “Avatars: Adventurer by Lisa Wischofsky / CC BY 4.0 (via DiceBear; customized).” Link artist/style and license.

400 assets: male-001.svg through male-200.svg and female-001.svg through female-200.svg. Presentation group names describe stylized presets, not real gender.

Recreate with npm ci then node generate.mjs.
